name: Afterlifes
detailed_description:
Overview

Explore 3 different biomes. Visit Dry Plains, Central Forest, and Snow County, but be careful, don't go to the Hazardous biome or the gas will kill you within seconds. Hunt Matacinas, kill as much as you can. Go looting and search every single dropped loot, in order to gather enough items. Chop trees, mine rocks, dig earth to gather resources. Craft tools, building blocks and decorations, and build your dream house in the middle of an apocalypse.

All these In Just Two Words: Freedom and Danger.

Who said that a world full of dangers and death can't be fun?

Short story

In the world's greatest war of all time, people were despairingly looking for the perfect soldiers. In the Delta Genetics Research Facility the scientists created a DNA that was believed to be the DNA of perfect humans, but they made a huge mistake... They have created the Matacinas. The chemical warfare left a deadly gas behind that killed most of humanity and Matacinas killed almost everyone who left. Survivors got sheltered in underground bunkers, except one survivor... Daniel Jackson. You are Daniel who is the only human survivor on the surface. You wake up in Stall Valley the only place with clean air. The governments of the old world hid the Machine somewhere in Stall Valley...

[H2]Road To Beta[/H2]

Afterlifes originally had it's flaws and bugs, and it didn't completely embody what it was meant to be. That's why Road To Beta was created in 2021. The process in which Afterlifes is being rebuilt from the ground up to make it the way it was always meant to be. Stay tuned for updates, and check out the roadtobeta Beta branch of the game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I5-8400 or AMD RYZEN 3 3300X
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3GB or AMD Radeon RX 570 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD (Preferred)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I7-8700K or AMD RYZEN 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 1080Ti or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD (Preferred)

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains hostile creatures. These creatures and the player use violence against each other. Also causing harm to a creature will lead to depiction of blood.
